dependency_chain: (M1A+M1B)+(M2A+M2B+M2C) -> OS axioms -> OS reconstruction -> nontrivial R4 Yang-Mills -> Spec(H) cap (0,m_G)=empty, 0<m_G<infinity

M1A_ALL_FIELD_RG_CONTROL.statement: For each fixed compact simple G, the exact Wilson/heat-kernel all-field RG from arbitrarily fine regulator to a fixed physical block admits localized effective actions with constants C_G,kappa_G independent of ultraviolet depth and volume, in a norm that feeds the terminal theorem.
M1A_ALL_FIELD_RG_CONTROL.target: sup_k ||E_k||_loc <= C_G and exact source-to-terminal norm dictionary

M1B_MASSIVE_TERMINAL_ENTRY.statement: At a finite physical blocking scale the exact effective action lies in a proven massive basin with explicit margin, and all later blocking preserves a uniform exponential correlation rate m_G>0.
M1B_MASSIVE_TERMINAL_ENTRY.target: terminal Hessian/KP/mixing inequalities with epsilon<K or equivalent Schur basin, uniform in volume

M2A_COMPOSITE_FIELD_UNIFORMITY.statement: For every finite family of gauge-invariant curvature differential polynomials, renormalized source insertions obey a regulator/volume-uniform Schwartz seminorm estimate.

M2B_O4_RESTORATION.statement: Hypercubic anisotropy of the renormalized Schwinger distributions vanishes uniformly on compact Schwartz sets.
M2B_O4_RESTORATION.target: |S_{n,a}(f)-S_{n,a}(f o R)| <= C_R a^alpha for dense R subset, then T11

M2C_SHORT_DISTANCE_YM.statement: The local continuum field family carries the asymptotically-free Yang-Mills short-distance expansion, including nonzero running interaction datum, stress tensor Ward identities, and OPE coefficients/remainders.
M2C_SHORT_DISTANCE_YM.target: beta(g)=-b0g^3+... plus uniform composite-source/OPE remainder control
